runs.question: customers per segment
runs.sql: SELECT Segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY Segment;

runs.question: total consumption per segment (FK JOIN)
runs.sql:
SELECT c.Segment,
       SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY total_consumption DESC;
